IND-RENT-BURDEN.title: Rent as a share of household expenditure
IND-RENT-BURDEN.source_table: Table 20.5 — Proportion of Rent to Household Expenditure by County and Residence, 2024
IND-RENT-BURDEN.definition: Total-column proportion of rent to household expenditure by county.
IND-RENT-BURDEN.limitation: Rent burden only; not a general cost-of-living index and not a prediction of an individual's rent.

IND-HOUSING-OWNER-OCCUPIED.title: Households owning their main dwelling
IND-HOUSING-OWNER-OCCUPIED.source_table: Table 3.6b — Percentage Distribution of Households by Tenure Status, Residence and County
IND-HOUSING-OWNER-OCCUPIED.definition: Percentage of households reporting that they own their main dwelling unit.
IND-HOUSING-OWNER-OCCUPIED.limitation: Tenure status is not itself a measure of housing quality, affordability or wealth.

IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-STOCK.title: Health facilities in the 2023 census target
IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-STOCK.source_table: Table 2 — County Summary; Facilities Targeted Over Facilities Assessed, Closed & Denied Access
IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-STOCK.definition: Facilities targeted for the Kenya Health Facility Census from the KMHFL list as at 1 August 2023.
IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-STOCK.limitation: A facility-stock/supply measure; it does not measure travel time, service quality, capacity or personal access.

IND-SCHOOL-ATTENDANCE-RATE.title: Population age 3+ at school/learning institution
IND-SCHOOL-ATTENDANCE-RATE.source_table: Appendix 2.2 — Distribution of School Attendance Status by Sex and County
IND-SCHOOL-ATTENDANCE-RATE.definition: Percentage of population age 3 years and above recorded as at school/learning institution.
IND-SCHOOL-ATTENDANCE-RATE.limitation: Age structure affects county comparisons; this is attendance status, not school quality or learning outcomes.

IND-LABOUR-FORCE-PARTICIPATION.title: Labour-force participation rate, age 15–64
IND-LABOUR-FORCE-PARTICIPATION.source_table: Table 3.19 — Labour Force Participation Rates for Population Age 15-64 Years by County, Residence and Sex
IND-LABOUR-FORCE-PARTICIPATION.definition: Total labour-force participation rate for population age 15–64 years.
IND-LABOUR-FORCE-PARTICIPATION.limitation: Labour-force participation is not the unemployment rate, job quality, earnings or probability of finding work.
